#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
using namespace std;

int n, mod, offset;
vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp;

int solve(int done, int i, int diff) {
    if (i == n) return diff > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    int &res = dp[done][i][diff + offset];
    if (res != -1) return res;
    int rem = n - i;
    long long ans = 0;
    for (int l = 0; l < rem; ++l) {
        int r_start = (done == 1) ? 0 : l;
        for (int r = r_start; r < rem; ++r) {
            ans += solve(done | (l < r ? 1 : 0), i + 1, diff + l - r);
            ans %= mod;
        }
    }
    res = (int)ans;
    return res;
}

long long solve2(int i) {
    if (i == n - 1) return 0;
    long long ans = (n - i) * 1LL * solve2(i + 1) % mod;
    int rem = n - i;
    for (int l = 0; l < rem; ++l) {
        for (int r = l + 1; r < rem; ++r) {
            ans += solve(1, i + 1, l - r);
            ans %= mod;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    cin >> n >> mod;
    offset = n * (n - 1);
    dp.assign(2, vector<vector<int>>(n, vector<int>(2 * offset + 1, -1)));
    cout << solve2(0) << endl;
    return 0;
}
